title: Customer Complaint Approval Form
use_case: Use the approval form during customer complaint intake, investigation, and recovery when the customer complaint record must identify customer account, contact, product or service, transaction, channel, affected location, and prior complaint history. Complete the applicable handoff for approved response, customer confirmation, credit or corrective action, root-cause referral, trend coding, and closure.
